regime.skew: flat at 25d (-0.05), near-money puts 2.7 vol points cheaper than calls, 10d wing put-rich
regime.label: Dealer short gamma reloaded to -5,896 baht/pt as a 2.21-sigma break drops spot 22.4 points below the static 1030 anchor
evidence: -5,896 baht/pt net dealer gamma within +/-20 points of 1007.6, against +90 yesterday and +93 on 14 Nov; cumulative net GEX never crosses zero across 950-1150 (chain total -7,937 baht/pt), so 1030 is the per-strike net-GEX sign boundary rather than a true cumulative flip, and the 1000 strike alone contributes -3,400.

-17.5 points today is 2.21x the 7.92-point 1-sigma, confirmed by 5,936 contracts of volume (2.53x yesterday's 2,348), ATM IV expanding 0.68 to 12.48% and OI building +2,169 - the Vol2Vol signature of real flow beating the option structure, so 1030 max pain is an anchor to measure from, not a magnet to trade toward.

1070 calls added +765 OI on 859 contracts and 1080 calls +307 on 482 - live new supply above spot - while the 1050 near-money call wall shed -27 OI on 488 volume (rolling up) and the 1100 overall call wall (2,855 OI) traded just 66 contracts and is stale 9.2% away.

-0.05 at 25d is a flat skew, but near-money puts are the cheapest vol in the chain - the 1010 put prints 11.13% against 13.84% on the 1010 call (-2.71) - while the 10d wing stays put-rich at 14.61% (960 put) versus 13.12% (1060 call).

S50Z26.today_summary: 1007.6 on the Dec future, -17.5 points (-1.71%), a 2.21-sigma break that leaves spot 22.4 points under the 1030 max pain and per-strike gamma boundary. Net dealer gamma within +/-20 points of spot collapsed to -5,896 baht/pt from +90 yesterday, with the 1000 strike alone at -3,400, so hedging now amplifies moves instead of damping them. ATM IV expanded 0.68 to 12.48%, still 1.79 points under 7 Nov's 14.27%, pricing a 7.92-point day. Volume ran 5,936 contracts against 2,348 yesterday and total OI added 2,169 (+6.1%) to 37,964 - a confirmed-flow break, not a drift.
what_changed: Net ATM dealer gamma flipped to -5,896 baht/pt from +90, a 5,986-unit swing in one session as spot fell into the put-heavy 1000/1020 strikes; the full chain went -1,179 to -7,937 (6.7x more negative).
1070 calls took +765 OI on 859 contracts and 1080 calls +307 on 482 - the chain's largest Vol2Vol-confirmed build - putting fresh call supply over 1070/1080 on a day the market fell 17.5 points.
P/C volume ratio collapsed to 0.63 from 1.11 as calls led 3,646 to 2,290 into a down day - the session's flow was call supply, not put panic.

960 put OI slipped -46 to 3,202 on 257 volume after +144 yesterday - the tail-insurance build stalled and today's put flow rotated up the ladder into 990 (+181), 970 (+165) and 1000 (+83 on the chain's largest put print of 402).
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Spot is -5.7 points net over five sessions (1013.3 on 11 Nov to 1007.6) but the path is the story: +12.9 to 1026.2 by 14 Nov, then -18.6 in the two sessions since. Dealer ATM gamma ran the same round trip - -3,347 baht/pt on 11 Nov, flat at +93 and +90 on 14-17 Nov while spot sat 4-5 points under max pain, then -5,896 today - so the flat-gamma drift window that defined last week has closed. Max pain has not moved off 1030 in eight sessions and the 1100 call wall (2,824 to 2,855) and 960 put wall (3,056 to 3,202) are equally static: the burden map itself is unchanged, only spot's position inside it has moved. ATM IV compressed 13.13% to 11.34% into 14 Nov and has since re-expanded 1.15 points to 12.48%, so this is a vol floor being left behind rather than a vol spike. Total OI is +3,463 (+10.1%) over the window to 37,964, and +1,415 of today's +2,169 landed in calls at 1070/1080 - the ladder above spot keeps getting heavier while spot falls away from it.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000 / 960
strategies.rationale: Buys the chain's cheapest vol (1000 put at 11.83% IV) and sells its richest (960 put at 14.61%) straight across the -3,400 baht/pt short-gamma pocket at 1000, where a break forces dealers to sell with the move toward the static 3,202-contract 960 put wall.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid. Max value 40 points (1000-960 width) less that debit.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1030 - max pain, the 25d call strike and the per-strike net-GEX sign boundary all at once.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1050 / 1080
strategies.rationale: Sells the 1050 near-money call wall (1,907 OI, 42.4 points or 5.4 sigma above spot) and buys 1080 behind today's +307 OI build, so the short strike sits under the fresh 1070/1080 supply that absorbed 1,341 contracts in one session.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 30 points (wing width) minus net credit received.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1050. Short gamma amplifies upside as well, so a reclaim of 1030 and then 1050 has dealers buying into that same 1070 supply.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1030 / 1060
strategies.rationale: Defined-risk cover for the other side of a -7,937 baht/pt chain: reclaiming 1030 puts spot back above the per-strike net-GEX boundary where dealer hedging held price flat for three sessions, and 12.48% ATM IV is still 1.79 points below 7 Nov's 14.27%, so that optionality is priced off the floor.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid. Max value 30 points (1030-1060 width) less that debit.
strategies.invalidation: No close above 1030 within the week, or ATM IV back under 11.5% with spot held inside 1000-1020 - theta then dominates a 41-day structure.

S50Z26.prediction: 22.4 points below the 1030 anchor with -5,896 baht/pt of dealer gamma under the money, the structural path of least resistance is continuation rather than mean reversion: losing the 1000 strike (2,312 put OI, 402 contracts traded today) hands short-gamma dealers a reason to sell into the 960/950 put mass 47.6 to 57.6 points lower. A close back above 1030 invalidates that read and restores the 14-17 Nov flat-gamma drift. Size for 7.92 points of 1-sigma daily range and expect both tails to be live, because short gamma accelerates moves in either direction.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and nothing here is an instruction to execute anything. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery and any pull toward 1030 is a tendency, not a guarantee - structurally weaker than pinning in share-settled single stocks. Defined-risk is not low-risk: the 30 and 40-point wing widths above are real maximum losses, and with net chain gamma at -7,937 baht/pt both directions can accelerate. The 1007.6 anchor is the December future rather than the cash index, and the figures come from a single 06:29 +07:00 snapshot of the 18 Nov chain.
